desc: Derive the high-level algorithm: maintain forward/backward anti-diagonal DP and update the answer in O(min(H,W)) per query.
Implement anti-diagonal DP maintenance in both numpy and pure-python paths; multilinear delta update ans += (a-old)*pre*suf.
Randomized stress test both paths against a brute-force enumerator (2500 tests, corners, zeros, repeats) -- ALL MATCH.
Extract the clean SOLUTION_SRC solver (drop the harness/brute-force/random-generator wrapper) so it reads stdin and writes stdout.
Run the two provided samples on the clean program and confirm exact expected output (456/666/822 and sample 2's six lines).
Ensure the program does not print debug/harness lines; guard the numpy import and keep the pure-python fallback so it runs even without numpy.
Sanity-check performance bound O(HW + Q*min(H,W)) with min(H,W) <= sqrt(200000) < 450; NP_THRESHOLD=0 selects the fast numpy path when available.
